name: Brog
summary: Monochrome creative studio site: a near-black hero with a giant tight-tracked wordmark laid over a centred duotone portrait, then white editorial sections with bracketed index labels, a 2x2 fashion-photo work grid and a dark numbered services list with pill tags.

fonts.pairing: one family: Inter Display 600 at very tight negative tracking (-4 to -8px) for 70 to 190px heads, 500 for 16 to 20px body and captions

signature: oversized wordmark with registered mark overlapping a centred square photo, a second word set big at the opposite corner
stacked uppercase discipline list in the hero's lower left as a typographic menu
bracketed zero-slashed index labels like (01) above every section head
dark services list: number, title and copy on the left, a cluster of white pill tags on the right, hairline separators
imagery: high-fashion editorial portraits with saturated single-colour backgrounds (sky blue, red, lime, deep blue duotone), square-cornered, full colour against an otherwise colourless UI
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 64px side padding, 120px section padding, 2-column work grid with 24px gaps, 0px radii except pill tags and buttons
